name: Life Domain
summary: A master healer: every slot-powered heal restores extra Hit Points, and Preserve Life rescues the Bloodied.

feature.name: Disciple of Life
feature.summary: Spells cast with a slot heal an extra 2 + the slot's level.
feature.text: When a spell you cast with a spell slot restores Hit Points to a creature, it regains an extra 2 + the slot's level Hit Points that turn.

feature.name: Life Domain Spells
feature.summary: Always prepared: Aid, Bless, Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration; more at levels 5, 7 and 9.

feature.name: Preserve Life
feature.summary: Channel Divinity: divide 5 × Cleric level Hit Points among Bloodied creatures within 30 feet (up to half their maximum).
feature.text: As a Magic action, spend a Channel Divinity use to restore Hit Points equal to five times your Cleric level, divided as you like among Bloodied creatures within 30 feet (you included). A creature can't be raised above half its Hit Point maximum this way.

feature.name: Blessed Healer
feature.summary: When your slot-powered spell heals someone else, you regain 2 + the slot's level.

feature.name: Supreme Healing
feature.summary: Healing dice from your spells and Channel Divinity always roll their maximum.
